findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe pickle deserialization in pandas
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // pandas.io.pickle functions
    call = API::moduleImport("pandas").getMember("io").getMember("pickle").getMember(["read_pickle", "to_pickle"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pandas").getMember(["read_pickle", "to_pickle"]).getACall() or
    // pickle module usage
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."
findings.hypothesis: Check for unsafe pickle deserialization in pandas
